title: Review of c14's catalyst-rods no-selection negative: replicated on fresh seeds 5 and 6 (after 40000 steps the heritable rate is 1.010 and 1.007 against 0.999 and 1.002 for the inert marker; 51-60% of the particles inside 14-18 rods)
summary: c14's yz.py unchanged on fresh seeds 5 and 6, 40000 steps, with the mutation settings of the finding (WORLD_P muy 0.01, sy 0.1, ymax 2; data/yz_s5.txt, yz_s6.txt). The rods settle at 14-18 (from 25-34 early on), 51-60% of the particles are inside rods at the late censuses, and the mean heritable production rate inside rods ends at 1.0097 and 1.0071 against 0.9992 and 1.0024 for the identical-event inert marker, with differences of 0.0-0.01 at every census and no trend: no selection, as reported. A labkit re-run with the same parameters on seed 5 (rerun/seed5, 10000 steps) shows the rods forming from noise by t~110 and dividing and merging (8 persistent splits, generation 2, merge/split 0.27; rerun/seed5/sheet.png).

observations.finding: data/yz_s5.txt and yz_s6.txt step=40000: y 1.0097/1.0071 vs z 0.9992/1.0024, in_rods 0.54/0.55, rods 17/17; y - z within 0.01 throughout both runs

controls_run.finding: identical-event inert marker z in the same runs (yz.py)

verdicts.limitation: t=2000 (40000 steps) only, as in the finding; a slow drift of the size seen (+0.01 in y over the marker on both seeds) could become selection in a much longer run, so 'not selected' is for this horizon. I did not test the sealing fixes the finding proposes.
